meta.title: Your account
meta.description: Your account details, study target, and the controls for exporting or deleting your data.

header.title: Your account
header.lead: What we hold, what you are working towards, and the controls to take your data with you or remove it.

guest.title: You are practising as a guest
guest.body: A guest session stores no email address and expires after seven days of not being used. <link>Create an account</link> in this browser to keep the practice, bookmarks and review queue you have built up.

details.heading: Your details
details.noEmail: None — guest accounts store no email address
details.minor: You told us you are under 16, so optional data collection stays switched off.
details.languageNote: To change the language, use the language menu at the top of any page. It changes the interface, not the practice questions.

settings.heading: Name and study target
settings.displayNameHint: Shown on your own pages only. Leave it empty to remove it.
settings.targetHint: Used to decide which exam your study pages open on. You can still practise any of them.
settings.examDateNote: Each exam has its own date, beside your goal for it. Set it in <link>Progress & readiness</link>.
settings.fallback: Those changes could not be saved.

billing.heading: Plans and billing
billing.guest: A plan needs an account. Create one first; your guest practice comes with you.
billing.staff: Editors and administrators have every exam and feature open, without a plan.
billing.cardUpdated: Your new card is saved and will be used for every plan.
billing.cardFailed: The new card was not confirmed. Your previous card is unchanged.

data.heading: Your data
data.downloadBody: One JSON file with your account details, every practice session and answer, your results, bookmarks, review queue, goals and study plans. Nothing else is included, and nobody else’s data can appear in it.
data.downloadNote: The file is generated when you click, so it is always current.
data.signOutBody: Ends this session on this device. Your data stays exactly as it is.
data.signOutFailed: We could not sign you out. Check your connection and try again.

delete.heading: Delete your account
delete.itemRecordWithEmail: your account record, including your email address
delete.itemSessions: every practice session, answer and timing record
delete.itemBookmarks: your bookmarks, your review queue and your study plan
delete.itemSignIns: every sign-in session, on this device and any other
delete.reports: Question reports you have sent us are kept for our editorial record, but they stop being linked to you. Nothing here can be restored afterwards, so download your data first if you want to keep it.
delete.labelEmail: Type your email address to confirm
delete.hintWord: Type {word}, in capital letters, to confirm.
delete.mismatchEmail: That does not match. Type {email} to confirm.
delete.mismatchWord: That does not match. Type {word}, in capital letters, to confirm.
delete.fallback: Your account could not be deleted.

footer: Our <link>privacy notice</link> explains what we store and why. If something here looks wrong, tell us before you delete anything — a deleted account cannot be brought back.

errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknownExam: That is not an exam we cover.
errors.confirmEmail: To confirm, type the email address on this account exactly.
errors.confirmWord: To confirm, type {word} in capital letters.
errors.deletionBlocked: Your subscriptions could not be cancelled just now, so the account was not deleted. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.unauthorized: You need to be signed in to do that.
errors.forbidden: This request was blocked for security reasons.
errors.serverError: Something went wrong on our side.
